column3: a short stretch of dungeon flagstone floor with a taut trip wire three inches above it, strung between two cracked, leaning timber supports that hold up a sagging slab of ceiling stone above
the same floor piece: the trip wire snapped and dangling, both timber supports toppled, the ceiling slab crashed down into a heap of broken rubble and dust
a weighted rope net bundled and suspended from a ceiling hook above a short stretch of floor, a thin trip wire stretched taut between two small stone columns below it
the same scene: the trip wire snapped, the weighted net fallen and spread flat over the floor, lead weights at its corners, empty ceiling hook above
a squat stone dragon-head statue on a plinth, mouth closed, faint ember glow in its nostrils, a square pressure plate set into the flagstones in front of it
the same statue and plinth, the pressure plate pressed down, the dragon head exhaling a roaring cone of orange magical flame toward the viewer
a square section of dungeon flagstone floor where one tile area is a hinged trapdoor lid painted to match the stones, only a hairline seam betraying it
the same floor section with the hinged lid swung open downward, revealing a dark square shaft ten feet deep
a piece of carved stone wall with a row of small dart tubes hidden among cobwebbed bas-relief, a square pressure plate in the floor below
the same wall and floor, the pressure plate pressed down, three poisoned darts with sickly green tips shooting out of the tubes in mid-flight
a heavy iron padlock on a strip of a wooden chest lid, the keyhole dark, a faint green glint deep inside it
the same padlock with a thin needle sprung out of the keyhole, its tip dripping a drop of green poison, a bent lockpick stuck in the lock
a massive round stone orb resting in a dark secret niche in a dungeon wall, a hidden pressure plate in the floor in front of it
the same massive stone orb rolling out of the niche along the floor, dust and stone chips flying, the pressure plate pressed down
a square section of dungeon flagstone floor where one area is a hinged trapdoor lid painted to match the stones, a faint metallic glint at its seam
the same floor section with the hinged lid swung open, revealing a dark pit bristling with sharpened iron spikes at its bottom
